epics.title: Customer Menu and Ordering
epics.description: Covers browsing the menu, adding items to a cart, selecting a pickup date and time slot, and cash‑on‑pickup payment.

source.quote: The menu and ordering pages are the highest priority.

tasks.title: Display product catalog
tasks.description: Customers must be able to browse a menu of products with a name, photo, price and description for each item.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each product shows its name, photo, price and description.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Customers must be able to browse a menu of products with a name, photo, price and description for each item.

source.quote: Customers must be able to browse a menu of products with a name, photo, price and description for each item.

tasks.title: Implement cart functionality
tasks.description: Customers must be able to add products to a cart and change the quantity of each item.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A product can be added to the cart and its quantity can be changed.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Customers must be able to add products to a cart and change the quantity of each item.

source.quote: Customers must be able to add products to a cart and change the quantity of each item.

tasks.title: Add pickup scheduling
tasks.description: Customers must choose a pickup date and a pickup time slot when placing an order.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A pickup date can be selected.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Customers must choose a pickup date and a pickup time slot when placing an order.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A pickup time slot can be selected.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Customers must choose a pickup date and a pickup time slot when placing an order.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Time slots are offered every 30 minutes between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Pickup time slots are every 30 minutes between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM.

source.quote: Customers must choose a pickup date and a pickup time slot when placing an order.

tasks.title: Display cash‑on‑pickup payment option
tasks.description: Payment is cash on pickup only; no online payment is needed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Only a cash‑on‑pickup payment option is presented.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Payment is cash on pickup only; no online payment is needed.

source.quote: Payment is cash on pickup only; no online payment is needed.

epics.title: Order Confirmation Email
epics.description: Send a confirmation email with an order number after the order is placed.

source.quote: After placing an order, the customer must receive a confirmation email with an order number.

tasks.title: Send order confirmation email
tasks.description: After placing an order, the customer must receive a confirmation email with an order number.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An email containing the order number is sent to the customer after order placement.
acceptance_criteria.quote: After placing an order, the customer must receive a confirmation email with an order number.

source.quote: After placing an order, the customer must receive a confirmation email with an order number.

epics.title: Admin Order Management
epics.description: Admin page for staff to view orders, update status, and manage menu items.

source.quote: The bakery staff need an admin page to view all orders for a selected date.

tasks.title: Admin order list view
tasks.description: The bakery staff need an admin page to view all orders for a selected date.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Staff can select a date and see all orders scheduled for that date.
acceptance_criteria.quote: The bakery staff need an admin page to view all orders for a selected date.

source.quote: The bakery staff need an admin page to view all orders for a selected date.
